label.explanation: Writes from payment-svc to S3 in us-east-1 fail with 500 InternalError / 503 ServiceUnavailable (lines 220, 229, 247, 254, 262) until the SDK's retry quota is exhausted (line 244). These are server-side errors from the cloud provider — not a credential (403) or configuration problem — and nothing on our side changed. order-service's errors (lines 237, 255, 266, 296, 303, 330) and the api-gateway 500s (lines 221, 238, 245, 250, 265, 274, 286, 298, 302, 307, 315, 326) are symptoms. Red herrings: line 211 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 85 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 94 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
